defaultValue: Shows the power sources graph from the Home Assistant energy dashboard: solar, battery and grid, stacked like in Home Assistant, with your consumption as a line. The sensors are read from your energy dashboard, so there is nothing to pick here.

items.label: URL
items.description: The address you open Home Assistant with, e.g. https://ha.example.org or http://192.168.1.10:8123. Your phone must be able to reach it.

items.label: Long-lived access token
items.description: Create one in Home Assistant under your profile, Security tab. It stays on the phone and is never sent to the watch.

items.defaultValue: The graph uses the power sensors of your energy dashboard (Settings > Dashboards > Energy): the power field of each solar, battery and grid source. Sources without one are left out. If your batteries also have a state of charge sensor there, a charge bar appears between graph and time.

items.label: Time span
items.description: The graph always ends at the current time and reaches back this far. It refreshes every five minutes.

items.label: Use night colours
items.description: Between the two times below, the watch switches to the night colours.

items.defaultValue: If background and text colour match, the watch falls back to a legible one. The graph colours follow Home Assistant: orange for solar, green for battery, blue for grid.
